data.title: Tropical Depression Fay (AT1), advisory 28/0234Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: FAY HOLDING ON AS A TROPICAL CYCLONE FOR NOW. As of 3:00 AM GMT Mon Sep 28 the center of Fay was located near 28.5, -43.8 with movement S at 6 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1012 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 30 mph.

data.title: Hurricane Polo (EP2), advisory 28/0549Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: LIFE-THREATENING WINDS AND FLASH FLOODS EXPECTED OVER PORTIONS OF BAJA CALIFORNIA SUR AND SONORA MONDAY AND TUESDAY. ...CONDITIONS EXPECTED TO BEGIN TO DETERIORATE MONDAY MORNING IN BAJA CALIFORNIA SUR... As of 11:00 PM MST Sun Sep 27 the center of Polo was located near 23.2, -114.0 with movement N at 10 mph. The minimum central pressure was 954 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 120 mph.

data.title: Tropical Storm Rachel (EP3), advisory 28/0547Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: RACHEL SLIGHTLY STRONGER. As of 12:00 AM CST Mon Sep 28 the center of Rachel was located near 13.2, -100.0 with movement WNW at 7 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1001 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 45 mph.
